title: 1st Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: The Speaker of the Majlis opens the sitting.
The Speaker invites the President to deliver the Presidential Address that the President must present to the Majlis under Article 84 of the Constitution.
President Dr Mohamed Muizzu delivers the Presidential Address.

summary: The first sitting of the year was a ceremonial opening at which President Dr Mohamed Muizzu delivered the annual Presidential Address.
